# --instructions--

Escribe una función `hasDuplicates(items)` que devuelva `true` si el array `items` contiene el mismo valor más de una vez, y `false` en caso contrario

```javascript
  catch (e) {

    console.log(`Test Case '--err-t${_testCount}--' failed`);
  }
```

# --seed--

```javascript
function hasDuplicates(items) {

}
```

# --asserts--

`hasDuplicates([1, 2, 3, 2])` debe devolver `true`.

```javascript
tryCatch(hasDuplicates([1, 2, 3, 2]) === true);
```

`hasDuplicates(["a", "b", "c"])` debe devolver `false`.

```javascript
tryCatch(hasDuplicates(["a", "b", "c"]) === false);
```

`hasDuplicates([])` debe devolver `false`.

```javascript
tryCatch(hasDuplicates([]) === false);
```

# --solutions--

```javascript
function hasDuplicates(items) {
  return new Set(items).size !== items.length;
}
```
